rules: Orders and policy decisions generated by the engine do not outrank the lawful commanding officer merely because they are optimized defaults.
When a decision domain belongs to the commanding officer, a player captain may accept, change, replace or delegate it subject to declared hard constraints.
Professional/external authorities retain their scoped powers even against the captain where the rules explicitly establish them.
A lawful but suboptimal captain order may execute and produce consequences rather than being silently corrected.
